notes: *of it* is one `added` unit rather than two: a supplied preposition and the supplied object standing before it do one office and stand together, which rule 2 partitions once; the italics corroborate (rule 7).
רֹכְבֵי אֲתֹנוֹת is read as a construct chain whose relation the ASV recasts as *on*, that word going to the rectum (rule 19), the unit discontinuous around *white*.
מִדִּין → *rich carpets* headed on *carpets*, *rich* being the ASV's supplied specifier (rule 31).
